evidence_boundary: Wild larvae collected from fruits of H. incana in March 2009; 5/15 pupated in rearing, but not all 15 shared a comparable control plant
One captured larva rejected H. incana fruits under the experiment; the larva later pupated on accepted Sisymbrium alternatives, not H. incana
Same larva fed indistinctly on fruits of S. erysimoides and S. irio over three days before pupation; NOT wild host acceptance
Same individual one larva consumed fruits of S. irio under captive conditions, despite host not previously reported; not documented wild feeding
